behaviour: GET /{locale}/requests lists every request the signed-in traveller has made, with guide link, creator, dates, party size and status.
Undecided requests can be withdrawn from the tracker; decided requests cannot.
Guests see a sign-in CTA; the guide-page request panel links to the tracker.
No new database objects: the page reuses the booking-request APIs.
honestLimits: No notifications: status changes are visible only when the traveller or creator visits the tracker/studio.
No pagination; the API returns all of a traveller’s requests (bounded by the 5-per-24h rule).
Verification accounts and the test request still exist in production and should be removed before real use.
